Which site should I choose?
A pull-through site is the practical choice for a quick I-80 overnight stop, especially for larger coaches and trailers. Back-in sites offer the same core full-hookup connection with a lower published nightly rate.
Availability can change, so call the park at 775-777-5529 before arrival to confirm the best option for your rig and stay length.
How much is an overnight RV site at Clark RV Park?
Current published rates are $55 per day plus tax for pull-through sites and $50 per day plus tax for back-in sites. Call to confirm current rates and availability.
